messages:
nina_sales: Heads-up: Helios Health wants a quick presales run for a 4	6M tokens/day commit. They need reserved GPUs, burst credits, monthly cap, and HIPAA notes. Can we turn a conservative/optimistic capacity + pricing sketch by EOD? @ash_presales @ryan_eng

ash_presales: Traffic snippet: baseline 30 rps, morning spike ~3x for ~15-25m, occasional short spikes. Median 80 tokens, p95 240. Require canary + AZ spread, BYOK/KMS and audit logs 12mo.

ryan_eng: Short calc: peak_rps = 30 * 3 = 90 rps; peak_tokens_sec = 90 * 240 = 21,600 tps. GPU throughput assumptions: conservative 8k tps, optimistic 13k tps. GPUs_needed_cons = ceil(21600/8000)=3, opt = ceil(21600/13000)=2. Recommend commit = 4 GPUs (3 production + 1 buffer) + burst pool = 2 GPUs for 30m/day. Note: quantization can cut GPU needs ~30% but test for quality regressions.

ash_presales: Autoscale draft: min=2, max=6, target_util=70%, step=+1, cooldown=90s, burst_pool=2, prewarm=300s. Canary: 5% 10m -> 20% 20m -> full; rollback if tail_latency >2x SLO or error_rate >1%.

leah_sre: KV warmup: run representative prompts at 1-2 rps/instance for 10m before peak. Add health checks: kv_hit_rate, tail_latency_ms, queue_depth. Runbook: if tail_latency >2x SLO for 3m -> enable burst pool and shift non-critical traffic to degraded path.

chris_sales: Commercial: they want a monthly cap + rollover burst credits and a reserved discount. Proposed: 12-mo commit -> 20% discount on reserved, burst bucket = 2 GPU-hrs/day with rollover up to monthly cap. Add quarterly usage review clause.

doc_bot: presales-pack/helios/capacity_calc_v1.pdf uploaded by ryan_eng at 1759001280

nina_sales: Action items: Ryan 1p capacity calc (conservative + optimistic) + quantization note; Ash 
draft autoscale JSON + canary; Leah 
security/runbook snippets & artifacts; Chris 
commercial language for cap/rollover. Target: assemble and send tomorrow AM; security answers within 3 business days. Thanks all :thumbsup:
